value_intent: Enable repository-mediated MIRA and Codex coordination without converting capability, recommendations, or artifact existence into Human authority.

excluded: modification or execution of sealed holdout cases

decision_responsibility: identify material uncertainty and Human decision points
evidence_responsibility: separate observation, inference, assumption, recommendation, and unknown
record observable results, failures, counts, hashes, and git state

actor_extension_rule: Additional actors may be added with explicit role, capability, decision responsibility, execution authority, and evidence responsibility; no defaults inherit authority.

WORK_CONTRACT.purpose: Describe requested work, intended value, constraints, and evidence requirements without itself proving Human approval.
WORK_CONTRACT.integrity_rule: Human Authorization binds the canonical SHA-256 of the complete Work Contract. Any material mutation invalidates that authorization.
WORK_CONTRACT.authority_rule: A MIRA-authored or Codex-authored Work Contract is a proposal unless separate valid Human Authorization exists. A verified Human-issued contract may directly authorize only the conditional Class 0 or Class 1 cases defined by the authorization matrix.

HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION.purpose: Record explicit Human authorization separately from requested work and recommendations.
HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION.authority_rule: Authorization grants only listed actions within listed budgets and scope. Silence grants nothing.

EXECUTION_EVIDENCE.purpose: Preserve append-only observable evidence for each execution attempt without modifying prior authority artifacts.
EXECUTION_EVIDENCE.append_only_rule: A later attempt references earlier evidence and never replaces it.
EXECUTION_EVIDENCE.unsupported_claim_rule: A result without observable support is UNKNOWN or HUMAN_VALIDATION_REQUIRED, never silently PASS.
EXECUTION_EVIDENCE.budget_rule: A dispatched external request consumes budget even when the response state is unknown.

pre_action_gate: exact provider, model, action, and resource match
required baseline and artifact hashes match

transitions.gate: contract shape and local policy validation pass
valid Human authorization evidence or permitted verified Human-issued Class 0/1 contract
pre-action gate passes immediately before action
append-only evidence records all actions, counts, and results
authorization, scope, budget, baseline, or integrity check fails
authorized action fails and failure evidence is preserved
material normative, authority, unsupported-evidence, or ambiguity boundary is reached
replacement contract or authorization explicitly references the superseded artifact

baseline_and_change_integrity.reinterpretation_rule: Approved or frozen content cannot be silently renamed, merged, omitted, weakened, strengthened, or expanded.

holdout_isolation.evidence_rule: Raw output is preserved before annotation and later layers reference hashes rather than rewriting earlier evidence.

partial_execution_recovery.resume_rule: Resume requires a fresh gate against current contract, authorization state, observed baseline, and remaining budget.

MC1.condition: MIRA-authored Work Contract requests one API call without Human Authorization
MC1.control: Class 2 requires a separate ACTIVE Human Authorization bound to the exact contract hash.

MC2.condition: Codex has credentials or tool capability but authorization is absent
MC2.control: Capability and credential presence are excluded from authorization evidence.

MC3.condition: One API request is authorized and a second is attempted
MC3.control: Append-only request count consumes the exact action budget at dispatch.

MC4.condition: OpenAI request authorized and Anthropic request attempted
MC4.control: Provider and operation must match authorization exactly.

MC5.condition: Local file change authorized and git push attempted

MC6.control: Authorization binds the canonical complete Work Contract hash.

MC7.condition: Observed baseline differs from authorized baseline

MC8.condition: Execution Evidence claims an action without observable support
MC8.control: Evidence claims require observable source references and explicit claim state.

MC9.condition: MIRA recommendation is treated as Human approval
MC9.control: MIRA has no execution authority by role and cannot issue Human Authorization.

MC10.condition: Prior authorization is reused for a materially different Work Contract
MC10.control: Contract ID, canonical hash, action, budget, and resource scope must all match.

minimum_implementation_hypothesis.implementation_boundary: The validator evaluates artifacts and proposed actions; a separate explicitly authorized executor remains responsible for any action.

counter_challenges.unnecessary_bureaucracy: Use three core artifact types only; Class 0/1 may rely on a verifiably Human-issued explicit contract unless a stricter boundary applies.
counter_challenges.mira_dependence: The protocol is actor-extensible and provider-independent; MIRA may draft but is not an authorization dependency or authority source.
counter_challenges.authorization_ambiguity: Canonical contract hash, exact action class, provider, resource scope, and budget are matched fail-closed.
counter_challenges.artifact_proliferation: No event log, workflow engine, or per-role schema is proposed; attempts append one evidence artifact each.
counter_challenges.stale_authorization_reuse: Any contract mutation or material scope mismatch invalidates authorization.
counter_challenges.evidence_laundering: Evidence claims carry observable references and epistemic state; unsupported claims remain UNKNOWN or require Human validation.
counter_challenges.holdout_contamination: Visibility allowlists and prohibited expectation fields are role-specific and hash-bound.
counter_challenges.partial_execution: Each attempt records dispatch and budget state; uncertain dispatch consumes budget and blocks automatic retry.

missing_design_decisions.question: What local evidence establishes that a Work Contract or Human Authorization was genuinely issued by the Human rather than merely authored with authorized_by set to HUMAN?
candidate_options: reviewed Git commit identity plus protected workflow
explicit out-of-band confirmation bound to artifact hash

missing_design_decisions.question: How will request and retry budgets be atomically reserved and consumed across concurrent executors?
